status: fixed candidate; ready for independent quality review
production_method: Direct Blender architecture, fixtures and decor; actual imported Kenney CC0 bench, bush and rock geometry; actual Poly Haven Hinoki PBR maps; existing source-derived NPCs; original generated mural used as a texture. No Image-to-3D step is claimed for this world.

visual_review.scope: Actual candidate GLB reimported into Blender. Cycles 24 samples with inspection lights. Upper walls and ceilings hidden only in overview. Static water previews and the existing five stool/basin pairs are QA-only additions after export; they are not included in the world GLB. Fixed fixture preview water is h-0.025, matching the prepared runtime adaptation.
resolved_findings: Removed coplanar wall caps/skirting and cabinet face overlaps that rendered black.
Stopped mirror horizontal rails inside vertical frame pieces to remove black corner intersections.
Rejected periodic stone/grout micro-patterns that read as visible stripes.
Rejected pancake-like stacked low rocks; used rounded rock_smallH/I source geometry, modest local weathering and welded smooth normals.
Matched fixed fixture water below the hollow rim; main bath/channel/pond water heights unchanged.
Preserved complete NPC shape in overview; high NPC geometry remains under seven independent transform slots.
visual_review.accepted_for_independent_review: Coherent cream/teal ceramics, Hinoki wood, recessed tubs/channels, source-derived furniture, smooth stone silhouettes and preserved openings. Runtime lighting, LOD transitions and full game composition still require the root integration review.

geometry_checks.clearance_scope: Narrow hole Y 0.05-0.45; crowd gaps Y 0.05-1.75; seven door interiors Y 0.05-1.4 excluding the intentionally locked sauna-door group. Boundary contact allowed. This is a geometric clipping check, not gameplay verification.
geometry_checks.surface_note: Architecture intentionally omits faces fully covered by other surfaces; recessed door/mirror faces use their existing carcasses for unseen thickness.

texture_checks.observed_warning: Image empty name not available; keeping packed image. All used packed images were subsequently reopened, decoded and checked finite/nonempty; all embedded GLB images were independently decoded after import. No missing texture was inferred from that warning.

not_performed: Browser or actual Three.js world rendering
provenance_detail: See measurements.json public_geometry_uses and npc_slots; original public source files remain unchanged. The downloaded rounded_square_tiled_wall set is not used by this world.
